podcast.title: Punk Subgenre
podcast.body: Anarcho punk emerged as one of the sub-genres into which punk rock mutated as it receded from the mainstream in the 1980s, preserving the punk attitude and DIY tenets. "It mutated into sub-genres like hardcore and oi and a narco punk."
